objective: Provide one additional spontaneous Life-Boat check-in each week without changing the existing morning check-ins or allowing unpinned inference spend.
requirements: The scheduler accepts and validates a random weekly local-time window such as 10:00-22:00.
A random weekly job persists one future occurrence and advances to a new occurrence after completion without duplicate firing on retries or restarts.
The live Life-Boat profile contains the unchanged Monday/Wednesday/Friday morning job plus exactly one active spontaneous check-in using the 10:00-22:00 window.
Both Life-Boat check-ins remain pinned to openai-codex and gpt-5.5 so global model drift cannot cause unintended spend.
knownFailures: The original morning job was skipped because it inherited global inference settings and its stored gpt-5.5 snapshot drifted to gpt-5.6-sol.
outOfScope: Do not change the existing morning prompt, Monday/Wednesday/Friday schedule, Telegram topic, or personal-coaching skill.
Do not trigger an inference call or send a Telegram message during verification.

successCriteria: Focused scheduler and provider-pin tests pass.
The installed runtime lists both expected Life-Boat jobs and the random weekly schedule.
The live job records show explicit openai-codex/gpt-5.5 routing and no unpinned inference axis.
failureSignals: The live profile has a missing, duplicated, paused, or differently scheduled check-in.
Either job has a null provider/model or the random job falls outside 10:00-22:00.
